Name: More Giant Crops
Author: spacechase0
TagLine: Add new giant crops to the game.
Description:
**More Giant Crops** lets you add new giant crops.

**Install**

1.  Install the latest version of [SMAPI](https://smapi.io).

2.  Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].

3.  Run the game using SMAPI.
**Use**
**Adding giant crops**
This mod doesn't include any crops by default; you need to download the textures you want to use. You can find available downloads by expanding the __Requirements__ section above, and checking the __Mods requiring this file__ list.

More Giant Crops will create an [font=Courier New]assets[/font] folder the first time you run it. You can add any number of giant crops as [font=Courier New].png[/font] images to this folder. For example, this adds garlic and parsnips as giant crops:
``

**For mod authors**
The name of each file must be the crop's produce ID (i.e. the key in [[font=Courier New]Data\ObjectInformation[/font]](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Object_data), or the __index of harvest__ field in [[font=Courier New]Data\Crops[/font]](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Crop_data)). The images must be exactly 48 pixels wide by 64 pixels high.

**Compatibility**
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.5+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.

**See also**

*   [Release notes](https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods/blob/develop/MoreGiantCrops/docs/release-notes.md#release-notes)

*   [Source code](https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods)
